findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:161–163` defines `HeckeCosetModule.single R D b := Finsupp.single D b`; `LeftCosetModule.lean:268–275` gives the same carrier and defines its `single` as exactly `Finsupp.single q b`. Both declarations require only `[Zero R]`, so the claimed coefficient-class distinction does not prevent specialization.
findings.fix: Define `LeftCosetModule Δ H R` as an abbreviation of `HeckeCosetModule Δ ⊥ H R`, delete `LeftCosetModule.single`, and use `HeckeCosetModule.single R` throughout; this retains the named module interface requested by API review without a second basis-constructor name.
findings.issue: `LeftCosetModule.single` directly duplicates `HeckeCosetModule.single R` specialized to `H₁ = ⊥`; both are coefficient-general wrappers around `Finsupp.single` on `HeckeCoset Δ ⊥ H`.

summary: The left-coset basis constructor still duplicates the existing coefficient-general Hecke-coset constructor; the requested named module can remain without a parallel constructor API.
